component.name: OPTIBubble
component.summary: Local computer-vision OMR grading with a mobile-bridge scanner

description.p: OPTIBubble turns any classroom into a scanning room: print dynamically generated MCQ answer sheets, let students photograph them with any phone browser over local Wi-Fi, and grade everything on the teacher's computer with OpenCV — in milliseconds, with zero cloud involvement.

Ambiguous marks (blank, double-marked, faint) are flagged for human review with cropped evidence images, and verified results export to CSV instantly. 100% local: no accounts, no telemetry, no internet required.
Initial release: sheet generator, mobile scanner bridge, OpenCV grading engine with confidence flagging, review queue and CSV export.
